Description

Site Engineer II

Location: Rozenburg, NetherlandsResponsibilities



  • Carry out planned and reactive maintenance on critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure.


  • Diagnose faults and complete repairs to maintain site uptime.


  • Monitor building systems and perform routine site inspections.


  • Coordinate contractors and oversee maintenance activities.


  • Respond to site incidents and support emergency procedures.


  • Complete maintenance documentation and update records.


  • Support junior engineers and contribute to continuous improvement.


  • Participate in an on-call rota where required.
Requirements



  • 2+ years' experience in a data centre, critical facilities or similar engineering environment.


  • Technical qualification in Electrical, Mechanical or Building Services Engineering.


  • Experience with planned and reactive maintenance.


  • Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills.


  • Knowledge of HVAC, electrical or mechanical systems.


  • Good communication skills and a strong commitment to health and safety.


Desirable


  • Experience with BMS, fire systems, CCTV/access control or lifts.


  • Previous experience supervising contractors or junior engineers.
